version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: This Salesforce skill is a disclosed Maton-based CRM integration with powerful but purpose-aligned read, write, and automation capabilities.

dimensions.detail: Network access, a Maton account, Salesforce OAuth, and Bash use are proportionate to a CRM API gateway skill. The artifact warns that Salesforce data may include personal and regulated business data and gives scoping guidance.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses pinned Maton CLI/SDK packages from npm, Homebrew, pip, and npm SDK examples. This is expected for the integration, but users should install only from the named Maton sources and upgrade deliberately.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions repeatedly require explicit user approval for new connections, writes, deletes, batch/composite operations, hosted functions, trigger destinations, and local --exec handlers; they also default to read/list operations and warn against broad exports.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: OAuth tokens, Maton connections, hosted functions, trigger destinations, environment variables, and watch checkpoints can persist beyond one session, but these behaviors are disclosed and tied to user-approved CRM automation workflows.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is Salesforce CRM administration via Maton OAuth, and the documented capabilities match that purpose: SOQL queries, sObject CRUD, composite operations, and optional hosted functions/triggers.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you want an agent to access Salesforce through Maton. Use the narrowest Salesforce scopes, prefer sandbox orgs for destructive or batch work, confirm the exact connection and record IDs before writes, and remove unused connections, functions, triggers, and destinations when finished.
